verdict.rationale: Founder Law mentions premium processing only as an item bundled into its flat-fee packages: the pricing page lists 'Premium Processing' among included government fees, and the About page says packages cover 'government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses'. That tells a founder they won't pay it separately, but nothing explains how Form I-907 actually works. Missing for 10: which classifications qualify for premium processing, the I-907 fee amount, what it speeds up (adjudication timeline) versus what it does not, and any educational content on its mechanics.
